#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <climits>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace std;

const int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

struct Scanner {
    char buffer[1 << 15];
    int k, l;
    Scanner() : k(0), l(0) {}
    char getc() {
        if (k >= l) {
            k = 0;
            l = fread(buffer, 1, sizeof(buffer), stdin);
            if (l <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buffer[k++];
    }
    int nextInt() {
        char c = 0;
        while (c <= 32) c = getc();
        int a = 0;
        while (c > 32) {
            a = a * 10 + c - '0';
            c = getc();
        }
        return a;
    }
} sc;

class CF1187G {
public:
    int n_, m_;
    vector<vector<int>> aa_;
    vector<int> pi, dd, bb;
    vector<int> uu, vv, uv, cost;
    vector<int> cc;
    vector<int> potential;
    priority_queue<pair<int,int>, vector<pair<int,int>>, greater<pair<int,int>>> pq;
    vector<bool> iq;

    void init() {
        aa_.resize(n_);
        for (int u = 0; u < n_; u++)
            aa_[u].clear();
        pi.resize(n_);
        dd.resize(n_);
        bb.resize(n_);
        uu.resize(m_);
        vv.resize(m_);
        uv.resize(m_);
        cost.resize(m_);
        cc.resize(m_ * 2);
        potential.resize(n_);
        m_ = 0;
    }

    void link(int u, int v, int cap, int cos) {
        int h = m_++;
        uu[h] = u;
        vv[h] = v;
        uv[h] = u ^ v;
        cost[h] = cos;
        cc[h << 1 ^ 0] = cap;
        aa_[u].push_back(h << 1 ^ 0);
        aa_[v].push_back(h << 1 ^ 1);
    }

    void enqueue(int v, int dist) {
        pq.push({dist, v});
    }

    int dequeue() {
        int v = pq.top().second;
        pq.pop();
        return v;
    }

    bool dijkstra(int s, int t) {
        fill(pi.begin(), pi.end(), INF);
        pi[s] = 0;
        pq = priority_queue<pair<int,int>, vector<pair<int,int>>, greater<pair<int,int>>>();
        enqueue(s, 0);
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            int u = dequeue();
            if (pi[u] < 0) continue;
            int d = dd[u] + 1;
            for (int h_ : aa_[u]) {
                if (cc[h_] > 0) {
                    int h = h_ >> 1;
                    int p = pi[u] + ((h_ & 1) == 0 ? cost[h] : -cost[h]) + potential[u] - potential[u ^ uv[h]];
                    int v = u ^ uv[h];
                    if (pi[v] > p || (pi[v] == p && dd[v] > d)) {
                        pi[v] = p;
                        dd[v] = d;
                        bb[v] = h_;
                        enqueue(v, p);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n_; i++)
            if (pi[i] < INF)
                potential[i] += pi[i];
        return pi[t] != INF;
    }

    void push1(int s, int t) {
        for (int u = t, h_, h; u != s; u ^= uv[h]) {
            h = (h_ = bb[u]) >> 1;
            cc[h_]--;
            cc[h_ ^ 1]++;
        }
    }

    int edmonds_karp(int s, int t) {
        fill(potential.begin(), potential.end(), 0);
        // SPFA for initial potentials
        {
            vector<int> qq(1 << 20);
            int head = 0, cnt = 0;
            iq.assign(n_, false);
            fill(pi.begin(), pi.end(), INF);
            pi[s] = 0;
            qq[head + cnt++] = s; iq[s] = true;
            while (cnt > 0) {
                int u = qq[head++]; cnt--; iq[u] = false;
                for (int h_ : aa_[u]) {
                    if (cc[h_] > 0) {
                        int h = h_ >> 1;
                        int p = pi[u] + ((h_ & 1) == 0 ? cost[h] : -cost[h]);
                        int v = u ^ uv[h];
                        if (pi[v] > p) {
                            pi[v] = p;
                            dd[v] = dd[u] + 1;
                            bb[v] = h_;
                            if (!iq[v]) {
                                if (head + cnt == (int)qq.size()) {
                                    vector<int> qq_(qq.size() * 2);
                                    copy(qq.begin() + head, qq.begin() + head + cnt, qq_.begin());
                                    qq = qq_;
                                    head = 0;
                                }
                                qq[head + cnt++] = v; iq[v] = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (pi[t] == INF) return 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n_; i++)
                if (pi[i] < INF)
                    potential[i] = pi[i];
            push1(s, t);
        }
        while (dijkstra(s, t))
            push1(s, t);
        int c = 0;
        for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++)
            c += cost[h] * cc[h << 1 ^ 1];
        return c;
    }

    void main() {
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        vector<int> ii(k);
        for (int h = 0; h < k; h++)
            ii[h] = sc.nextInt() - 1;
        vector<vector<int>> aa(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            aa[i].clear();
        for (int h = 0; h < m; h++) {
            int i = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int j = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            aa[i].push_back(j);
            aa[j].push_back(i);
        }
        int t = n + k + 1;
        n_ = n * t + 1;
        m_ = k + (m * 2 * k + n) * (t - 1);
        init();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            vector<int>& adj = aa[i];
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                int u = i * t + s;
                for (int j : adj) {
                    int v = j * t + s + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++)
                        link(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                int u = i * t + s, v = u + 1;
                link(u, v, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
            }
        for (int h = 0; h < k; h++)
            link(n_ - 1, ii[h] * t + 0, 1, 0);
        cout << edmonds_karp(n_ - 1, 0 * t + t - 1) << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    CF1187G solver;
    solver.main();
    return 0;
}
